title: Efinix Ti180 MLPerf Tiny benchmark result record
description: One JSON object per benchmark result file under results/. Every number quoted in README.md, docs/, or any slide must trace back to a file validating against this schema. Estimates and measurements are distinguished by the top-level 'kind' field and may never be conflated. Adapted from the Agilex 3 campaign schema (D:/altera_demo/agilex_mlperf_demo) so records stay comparable.

kind.description: estimate = produced by a static/analytical model or a simulator. measured = produced by executing the workload and reading a real clock/counter.

benchmark.description: Workload identifier: the four MLPerf Tiny closed-division tasks.

stage.description: Which point in the pipeline produced this record. 'accel_estimate' is any pre-silicon projection (analytical model, simulator, or op-latency extrapolation). 'hw_memtest' is an on-board memory-datapath integrity test that scores no inferences, so it does not require clk_core_mhz or accel_config.

timestamp_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant the record was produced, e.g. 2026-08-28T22:52:54Z.

producer_script.description: Repo-relative path of the script that wrote this file. Must not be absolute and must not escape the repo.

run_host.description: Machine identifier the run happened on (hostname, or host+board for hardware runs). REQUIRED when kind == "measured".

notes.description: Free-form human commentary. Never a place to hide numbers -- anything quantitative belongs in metrics.

config.description: Everything needed to reproduce the record.

device.description: FPGA part number, e.g. Ti180J484C4. For CPU reference stages, the CPU model string.

board.description: Board identifier, e.g. Efinix Ti180 J484 Development Kit. Use "n/a" for host-CPU reference stages.

tool_versions.description: Snapshot of the relevant toolchain versions, e.g. {"efinity": "2026.1.132.3.9", "riscv_gcc": "...", "tflite_micro": "..."}.

clk_core_mhz.description: Actual SoC / TinyML-accelerator core clock frequency in MHz that the hardware ran at (from the fitted/STA-signed-off design, not the requested constraint).

accel_config.description: TinyML accelerator / SoC configuration identifier (accelerator parameter set, SoC config name, or config file path).

bitstream_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact .bit/.hex programmed onto the board.

metrics.description: The actual numbers. Open-ended, but the well-known keys are typed here so units can't drift.

top1_pct.description: Top-1 accuracy in PERCENT (0-100), not a fraction.

n_records.description: Number of inputs scored / inferences timed.

allOf.$comment: measured results must name the machine they were measured on.
hw_* inference stages must pin the clock, the accelerator config, and the exact bitstream.
accel_estimate records are specific to an accelerator configuration.
